resources.string: Double-tap the back of your phone (Quick Tap) or tap the accessibility button in any app to make the text on screen selectable.\n\nWhen you open Lasso, it takes a screenshot and recognizes the text in it, so you can select that text. It also watches for the Back key while open, to close. Everything is processed on the phone. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere: the app has no internet access.
